brief:
Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar met with Moroccan Foreign Minister Nasser Bourita and U.S. Ambassador Thomas Niles at a trilateral summit in New York, the Ma'an news agency reported. The three officials announced plans to upgrade diplomatic representation between Israel and Morocco.

The two countries will establish full embassies and exchange ambassadors, marking a significant step in their diplomatic relations.

title: Israel, Morocco elevate diplomatic ties to ambassador level
